title: Diner Soundtrack
content: Sometimes in a crowded restaurant or movie theater, I like to defocus my brain and try to listen to all the conversations going on around me at once.Usually I can't distinguish more than phrases, snapshots. In this case, I sketched one group at one table, but the snippets of dialogue came from other people all around me.Jotting down actual dialogue is good practice for writers, and it's a good way to get a sense of thezeitgeist.
